There are very interesting growth stories happening within the RWA space right now.

I think everyone is somewhat familiar with the broad RWA sector growth - tokenized RWAs are up 400%+ since early 2025, now $30B+. 

Tokenized stocks have been the fastest-moving, up roughly 5x in a year to $2B+.

But alongside tokenized stocks there's this concept of tokenized active strategies. While a tokenized Treasury or stock is passive (it holds one asset and tracks it), an active strategy is a token representing a managed fund or vault. Think basis trades, delta-neutral positions, hedge-fund strategies.

It's a tokenized asset where someone is actively trading to generate a return. And it's a nice alternative for those who want this kind of product, but don't want to set up these trading strategies themselves.

I've personally been exploring strategies like this with my wealth advisor and am happy to see onchain alternatives spin up and grow.

As for where it's happening onchain (per RWA dot xyz):
→ Ethereum ~$2.0B
→ Stellar ~$821M
→ Avalanche ~$194M
→ Mantle ~$118M
→ Monad ~$111M

I'm expecting this specific niche of tokenized RWAs to continue to soar this cycle as RWAs level up onchain.

The bull case for Big Tech rests on one spreadsheet assumption.

Wall Street's models put the five hyperscalers' operating margin at 31% in 2029, up from 27% in 2025, even as they spend trillions on AI. Half of that gain requires overhead, SG&A, to fall from 10% to 8% of revenue while revenue nearly doubles past $3 trillion.

That is a $77 billion assumed efficiency, and it has never happened at this growth rate. Depreciation from the new data centers is about to soar, and Amazon, Oracle and Alphabet are already free-cash-flow negative.

The multiples are priced on a forecast that overhead shrinks while revenue doubles. If AI does not deliver that cost cut, margins compress and the whole valuation breaks.
